pass.answer: ARTIFACT_PULL_TOKEN is declared in -Secrets, so it resolves before the first stage from the environment, a file, your vault, or one hidden prompt.
Set ARTIFACT_PULL_TOKEN as an environment variable before you launch, or the script asks once at a hidden prompt.
At run time the script sets `$env:ARTIFACT_PULL_TOKEN = Read-Host -AsSecureString 'Token'`, so the token never reaches the chat.
